headline: Infragora Plans $1 Billion Investment for Two AI-Ready Data Centres in Nigeria
summary: INFRAGORA plans to begin building two AI-ready data centres in Nigeria by Q2 2027, backed by up to $1 billion in proposed investments and dedicated power infrastructure.
why: Expanding digital infrastructure in emerging markets addresses critical cloud capacity constraints, though securing reliable local power and capital financing remains challenging.

impacts.name: African Technology
impacts.why: Large-scale data centre investments provide foundational infrastructure for local cloud adoption and artificial intelligence services.
